serverConfig.title: Interface network
serverConfig.addressLockedTip: The subnet and mask are set once at creation and can't be changed later — shrinking the range could strand existing peers outside it.

mtu.label: MTU
mtu.tip: Maximum packet size on the interface. Empty = default (usually 1420). Lower it (e.g. to 1280-1380) if the connection works but large requests hang or drop — typical for mobile internet, PPPoE, or when this VPN itself runs through another tunnel. Applies to both the server and new client configs.

obfuscation.label: AmneziaWG obfuscation
obfuscation.tip: Traffic-masking parameters that disguise the tunnel as ordinary noise — the same values must be set in the client config as well

openvpnTuning.title: MTU / mssfix
openvpnTuning.description: Adjust these if the connection works but large requests hang or drop — typical for mobile internet, PPPoE, or when this VPN itself runs through another tunnel. Applies to both the server and new client configs.

tunMtu.label: tun-mtu
tunMtu.tip: MTU size of the tunnel interface. Empty = OpenVPN default.

mssfix.label: mssfix
mssfix.tip: Clamps TCP MSS instead of changing the interface MTU — a gentler way to work around packet fragmentation. Empty = leave unset.

openvpnTuning.savedMessage: Saved — the server has been reconfigured and the service restarted

mesh.title: Network & service
mesh.meshEnabledTip: This provider's clients get routes into the shared network without NAT (other VPN transports + site subnets)
mesh.egress: Route internet traffic through this server
mesh.egressTip: Clients route all other traffic (not just mesh) through this server
mesh.autoAssignRangeTip: Restricts which part of the subnet auto-provisioning (access-request grants, node grants) picks an address from -- like a DHCP pool on a router. Empty = whole subnet, no restriction.

ca.title: Certificate authority (CA)
ca.description: Import an external CA instead of the self-signed one the panel generates by default. After importing you need to run "Configure server" again — existing client certificates will need to be reissued.
ca.importedMessage: CA imported — click "Configure server" on the Overview tab to apply

backups.title: Config backups

preview.label: Preview
preview.tip: First 200 characters of the saved config file

backups.restoreConfirm: Restore config from the backup dated {{date}}? The current config will be replaced.
